analyzerVersion.description: Semver of the feature contract plus model ids; part of the cache key

reason.description: Set exactly when the gate did not pass

confidence.description: Estimator confidence normalised to 0..1 by the audio service; null when the estimator gives none. Essentia's RhythmExtractor2013 reports 0 to 5.32: the service divides by 5.32 and clips to 0..1, and keeps the reported value in rawConfidence.

rawConfidence.description: The confidence as the estimator reported it, with its scale

tonic.description: Spelled with sharps; the service maps flat names (Bb -> A#)

strength.description: Key strength from the estimator; null when none

rmsMean.description: Mean RMS amplitude, linear, full scale = 1

values.description: RMS per hop, from the start of the preview

time.description: Seconds from the start of the preview
